description: Pick part of the tree with a subset of JSONPath (RFC 9535): $, .name, ['name'], [0], *, [*], and .. for any depth.

added.parse(text): Query text to a list of steps { key, deep }.
added.find(tree, text): Every path in the tree that matches.
added.run(tree, { select, omit }): A copy of the tree with only what select matches, minus what the omit queries match. Left-out parts become { "#": hash } so the result still verifies. Async.
